// SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-only
// Test inputs/oracles: Copyright Grafana Labs contributors; adjacent LICENSE applies.
// Standard-library-only AST extraction; never executes Loki/Pulse or constructors.
// Usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki > label-parsing.json
package main

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/base64"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"go/ast"
	"go/constant"
	"go/parser"
	"go/token"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strconv"
	"unicode/utf8"
)

const revision = "5aa4b9212d64d723f63b2770452054aa23df114d"

type object map[string]any
type source struct {
	path string
	data []byte
	fs   *token.FileSet
	file *ast.File
}

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}
func hash(data []byte) string { return fmt.Sprintf("%x", sha256.Sum256(data)) }
func load(root, path, want string) *source {
	data, err := os.ReadFile(filepath.Join(root, path))
	must(err)
	if hash(data) != want {
		panic("source differs from pinned revision: " + path)
	}
	fs := token.NewFileSet()
	f, err := parser.ParseFile(fs, path, data, parser.ParseComments)
	must(err)
	return &source{path, data, fs, f}
}
func (s *source) code(n ast.Node) string {
	return string(s.data[s.fs.Position(n.Pos()).Offset:s.fs.Position(n.End()).Offset])
}
func (s *source) record(n ast.Node) object {
	a, b := s.fs.Position(n.Pos()), s.fs.Position(n.End())
	return object{"source": s.path, "original_go": s.code(n), "source_range": object{
		"start_line": a.Line, "start_column": a.Column, "end_line": b.Line, "end_column": b.Column,
		"start_byte": a.Offset, "end_byte_exclusive": b.Offset}}
}
func (s *source) selection(name string, n ast.Node) object {
	r := s.record(n)
	text := s.code(n) + "\n"
	r["name"], r["original_go"], r["sha256"] = name, text, hash([]byte(text))
	return r
}
func (s *source) function(name string) *ast.FuncDecl {
	for _, d := range s.file.Decls {
		if f, ok := d.(*ast.FuncDecl); ok && f.Name.Name == name {
			return f
		}
	}
	panic("missing function: " + name)
}
func stringValue(e ast.Expr) string {
	lit, ok := e.(*ast.BasicLit)
	if !ok || lit.Kind != token.STRING {
		panic("expected original string literal")
	}
	v, err := strconv.Unquote(lit.Value)
	must(err)
	return v
}

// Evaluate only integer literals and shifts in the original size expressions.
// This does not evaluate source calls or allocate a repeated input string.
func integer(e ast.Expr) constant.Value {
	switch x := e.(type) {
	case *ast.BasicLit:
		if x.Kind == token.INT {
			return constant.MakeFromLiteral(x.Value, token.INT, 0)
		}
	case *ast.BinaryExpr:
		left, right := integer(x.X), integer(x.Y)
		if x.Op == token.SHL {
			n, ok := constant.Uint64Val(right)
			if !ok || n > 63 {
				panic("unsupported shift")
			}
			return constant.Shift(left, x.Op, uint(n))
		}
		if x.Op == token.SUB {
			return constant.BinaryOp(left, x.Op, right)
		}
	}
	panic("unsupported integer expression")
}
func intValue(e ast.Expr) int64 {
	v, ok := constant.Int64Val(integer(e))
	if !ok {
		panic("integer not representable")
	}
	return v
}
func calls(s *source, n ast.Node, names ...string) []object {
	out := []object{}
	ast.Inspect(n, func(n ast.Node) bool {
		if c, ok := n.(*ast.CallExpr); ok {
			for _, name := range names {
				if s.code(c.Fun) == name {
					out = append(out, s.record(c))
				}
			}
		}
		return true
	})
	return out
}
func extract(s *source, name string) object {
	fn := s.function(name)
	executor := fn.Body.List[0].(*ast.RangeStmt)
	table := executor.X.(*ast.CompositeLit)
	rows := []object{}
	pairCount := 0
	for i, elt := range table.Elts {
		var input, output ast.Expr
		var desc string
		if name == "TestParseLabels" {
			row := elt.(*ast.CompositeLit)
			if len(row.Elts) != 3 {
				panic("unexpected label row shape")
			}
			for _, field := range row.Elts {
				kv := field.(*ast.KeyValueExpr)
				switch s.code(kv.Key) {
				case "desc":
					desc = stringValue(kv.Value)
				case "input":
					input = kv.Value
				case "output":
					output = kv.Value
				default:
					panic("unexpected row field")
				}
			}
		} else {
			input = elt
			desc = stringValue(input) // Original t.Run(query, ...) name.
		}
		query := stringValue(input)
		if !utf8.ValidString(query) {
			panic("non-UTF-8 source input")
		}
		r := s.record(elt)
		r["table"], r["source_index"], r["name"] = name, i, desc
		r["query"], r["query_expression"] = query, s.code(input)
		r["query_bytes_base64"], r["query_utf8_valid"] = base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(query)), true
		r["reject"], r["expected_error"] = false, nil
		r["expected_labels_present"], r["expected_labels_expression"], r["expected_labels"] = output != nil, nil, nil
		if output != nil {
			call := output.(*ast.CallExpr)
			if s.code(call.Fun) != "labels.FromStrings" || len(call.Args)%2 != 0 {
				panic("expected original labels.FromStrings pairs")
			}
			pairs, args := []object{}, []object{}
			for j, arg := range call.Args {
				args = append(args, s.record(arg))
				if j%2 == 0 {
					pairs = append(pairs, object{"name": stringValue(arg), "value": stringValue(call.Args[j+1])})
				}
			}
			oracle := s.record(output)
			oracle["constructor_expression"], oracle["arguments"] = s.code(call.Fun), args
			r["expected_labels_expression"], r["expected_labels"], r["expected_labels_source"] = s.code(output), pairs, oracle
			pairCount += len(pairs)
		}
		rows = append(rows, r)
	}
	parsers := calls(s, executor.Body, "ParseLabels", "ParseExpr")
	assertions := calls(s, executor.Body, "require.Equal", "require.NoError")
	if len(rows) != 4 || len(parsers) != 1 || len(assertions) != 1 {
		panic("pinned table counts differ")
	}
	if (name == "TestParseLabels" && pairCount != 6) || (name != "TestParseLabels" && pairCount != 0) {
		panic("pinned output pair count differs")
	}
	return object{"name": name, "selection": s.selection(name, fn), "table": s.record(table),
		"executor": s.record(executor), "parser_calls": parsers, "assertion_calls": assertions,
		"row_count": len(rows), "accepted_count": len(rows), "rejected_count": 0,
		"label_pair_count": pairCount, "rows": rows}
}
func oversized(s *source) object {
	fn := s.function("TestParseLabels")
	if len(fn.Body.List) != 4 {
		panic("unexpected trailing control statements")
	}
	construction := fn.Body.List[1].(*ast.AssignStmt)
	call := construction.Rhs[0].(*ast.CallExpr)
	if s.code(construction.Lhs[0]) != "input" || s.code(call.Fun) != "strings.Repeat" || len(call.Args) != 2 {
		panic("unexpected repeat construction")
	}
	repeated, count := stringValue(call.Args[0]), intValue(call.Args[1])
	if len(repeated) != 1 || count != 1<<24 {
		panic("pinned repeat geometry differs")
	}
	executor, assertion := fn.Body.List[2], fn.Body.List[3]
	parsers := calls(s, executor, "ParseLabels")
	assertions := calls(s, assertion, "require.Error")
	if len(parsers) != 1 || len(assertions) != 1 || s.code(executor) != "_, err := ParseLabels(input)" || s.code(assertion) != "require.Error(t, err)" {
		panic("unexpected oversize executor/assertion")
	}
	return object{"name": "TestParseLabels.trailing_oversized_input", "table": "TestParseLabels",
		"control_index": 0, "reject": true, "expected_error": nil, "error_oracle": "presence_only",
		"construction": s.record(construction), "query_expression": s.code(call),
		"repeat_expression": s.code(call.Args[0]), "repeat_bytes_base64": base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString([]byte(repeated)),
		"repeat_byte": int(repeated[0]), "repeat_count_expression": s.code(call.Args[1]), "repeat_count": count,
		"query_byte_count": int64(len(repeated)) * count, "materialized": false,
		"executor": s.record(executor), "parser_calls": parsers, "assertion": s.record(assertion), "assertion_calls": assertions}
}
func main() {
	if len(os.Args) != 2 {
		panic("usage: producer /path/to/pinned/loki")
	}
	s := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/syntax/parser_test.go", "0a8466fd5d9cab3f852f9a18a52dc54b7b1a1ab0c9c6af53ca1df21d9f38ce99")
	p := load(os.Args[1], "pkg/logql/syntax/parser.go", "a38e8d4760af3969d5316e456db8abed93655a66fd81f8cfdd2fa50226142667")
	support := []object{}
	for _, name := range []string{"ParseLabels", "ParseMetric"} {
		fn := p.function(name)
		r := p.selection(name, fn)
		r["documentation"] = p.record(fn.Doc)
		support = append(support, r)
	}
	var size object
	for _, d := range p.file.Decls {
		if g, ok := d.(*ast.GenDecl); ok && g.Tok == token.CONST {
			for _, spec := range g.Specs {
				if v, ok := spec.(*ast.ValueSpec); ok && len(v.Names) == 1 && v.Names[0].Name == "maxStreamLabelsSize" {
					// Keep the complete enclosing const declaration, including comments.
					size = p.selection("maxStreamLabelsSize", g)
					size["value_spec"], size["value_expression"], size["value"] = p.record(v), p.code(v.Values[0]), intValue(v.Values[0])
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if size == nil || size["value"] != int64(1<<24-1) {
		panic("pinned size declaration differs")
	}
	support = append(support, size)
	sources := []object{}
	for _, src := range []*source{s, p} {
		sources = append(sources, object{"path": src.path, "sha256": hash(src.data)})
	}
	out := object{"schema_version": 1, "revision": revision, "sources": sources,
		"supporting_declarations": support, "tables": []object{extract(s, "TestParseLabels"), extract(s, "TestParseUnreservedWordsAsLabelNames")},
		"controls": []object{oversized(s)}, "row_count": 8, "accepted_count": 8, "rejected_count": 0,
		"label_pair_count": 6, "control_count": 1, "rejected_control_count": 1, "exact_error_count": 0}
	encoder := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout)
	encoder.SetIndent("", "  ")
	must(encoder.Encode(out))
}
